prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Tobias Reyne for the job below.

About the freelancer: 7 years experience; skills: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML and CSS

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Shopify 2.0 Website Development
I am looking for a highly experienced and reliable freelancer to build me an e-commerce website using Shopify. I need custom development of some kind for this project. The website should have a sleek, modern design and encourage fast & easy navigation amongst products, categories, and checkout. It should also be optimized for both desktop and mobile devices. Understanding UX and good coding practices is a must. If you have prior experience with developing Shopify websites and feel confident that you could handle what is required of this project, then please get in touch with me. I look forward to hearing from you.
</job>

(none)

Style:
- Open by restating the client's specific problem in one sentence.
- Do not mention any specific past project or client.
- Write 300 to 380 words.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
You need a Shopify 2.0 e-commerce site with custom development, a sleek modern design, and a fast, easy experience for browsing products, categories, and checkout on both desktop and mobile.

Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne, and I’d be glad to help you build this. I have 7 years of experience working across full stack web development, with a focus on JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API development, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. While Shopify is a different platform than the stack I usually work with, I’m very comfortable with custom front-end and back-end development, UX-focused builds, and clean implementation practices that support speed, maintainability, and a polished user experience.

For a project like this, my approach would be to keep the storefront simple to navigate, visually modern, and optimized for conversion. That means making product discovery intuitive, keeping category flows clear, and reducing friction in the path to checkout. I also pay close attention to responsive behavior so the experience remains smooth and consistent across mobile and desktop devices.

I understand the importance of good coding practices and careful UX decisions in e-commerce. A site like this needs more than a nice look — it needs structure, clarity, and performance. I would approach the build with that in mind, ensuring the design feels sleek while the interactions stay fast and straightforward for customers.

If you’re looking for someone reliable who can handle custom development thoughtfully and build a professional Shopify experience that feels modern and easy to use, I’d be happy to discuss the scope further.

What specific custom functionality or storefront behavior do you want the Shopify site to include?
